parsed.explanation: The quote accurately describes only a discretized search whose results “suggest” a guarantee. The write-up explicitly labels the formula a conjecture, says the lower bound “needs” proof, and leaves the Full proof section empty. Thus it contains no all-n argument against every Xiang reply. Furthermore, for n≥3, (n+1)/(2n+1) is strictly greater than the correct value 2^n/(2^(n+1)-1), so the proposed guarantee cannot be proved. The lower-bound obligation therefore remains unfulfilled.
